# A-one road / エーワンロード株式会社

> Global Manufacturing Technology. Delivered to Japan.
> A Japan-based Value-Added Distributor for manufacturing equipment, materials and technology.

## Current business
A-one road supports product localization, Japanese product listings and visibility, first-line inquiry handling and distribution under agreed scope and rights. Active sales, technical evaluation, PoCs, installation and integration are individually scoped in an SOW.

## Strategic technology areas
- General Purpose: versatile production equipment, including CNC machining centers and NC lathes.
- Scarce Advanced: LFAM, WAAM, composites and advanced manufacturing processes.
- Feedstock & Materials: metal powders, wire, polymers and manufacturing inputs.
- Complementary industrial technologies, such as inspection, automation and industrial software, may also participate in the VAD model.
These are selection priorities and examples. Specific product availability and distribution rights are confirmed individually.

## Engagement
Initial discussion → MNDA → MSA → SOW → initial payment and content preparation → OEM approval and launch. Fees and duration are provided through a proposal.

## Company
- Legal entity: エーワンロード株式会社
- Brand: A-one road
- Established: March 2021
- Founder and representative director: Kazuma Tamura
- Base: Yokohama, Japan
- Contact: admin@a1-road.com
- Languages: Japanese and English
- Mission: すべての正当な価値を取り戻す。
- Vision: Unearth All Hidden Values.
- Slogan: Make Matter Matter.
